title: Coexistence from First Principles
description: A layered reconstruction of Madhyasth Darshan's ontological core, activity-duration, order-relative stability, and knowledge-order cycles, with explicit boundaries between textual doctrine, formal organization, mathematical analogy, and open posits

title: A State Dynamic Model of Coexistence
description: A typed qualitative hybrid reconstruction of Madhyasth Darshan: state-complete satta and state-dynamic units; effort-motion-result and the tetrad; typed composition and T1; pranic, animal, and human joint forms; evaluation, completeness, and evidence. Direct textual claims remain distinct from analytical transition, graph, and observation structures.
